PRINCIPLE: The app should feel like a game, not a chore. Every interaction reinforces reward.
DESIGN PILLARS:
- Dark theme throughout
- Liquid Glass (iOS 26 .glassEffect) on all interactive surfaces
- KEEP/DELETE stamp overlays on card tilt
- Session Complete screen: confetti + stats (reviewed/deleted/kept/GB freed) + streak counter → dopamine hit
- Haptic feedback is a top priority (not just visual)
- Progress bar + stats ribbon on main screen ("47 of 312", GB freed counter)
- Premium filter chips with lock icons + PRO badges in bottom sheet
